information_sections.title: Qualifications to Register
items: 17½ years of age or older; you must be 18 years old to vote
Not serving a sentence for a felony involving moral turpitude
Not having been adjudicated mentally incompetent

information_sections.title: Ways to Register
items: Department of Public Safety when applying for or renewing a driver's license
Department of Human Services public assistance offices, including WIC, DFCS, rehabilitation, and other offices serving people with disabilities
County courthouses, city halls, colleges, and high schools
Board of Elections and Registration office

information_sections.title: What to Do if You Move
paragraphs: Voters are required to notify the board of registrars in their county of residence whenever they move. Use the address and telephone number listed above.

If you move within the same county and do not notify the Board at least 30 days before an election, you may vote at your old polling place for that election. You must file notice of your new address by writing the county Board of Elections and Registration office or by submitting a new voter registration application.
If you move outside the county within 30 days of an election, you may vote in your old precinct for that election.
If you move outside the county more than 30 days before an election, you are no longer eligible to vote in your former county. You must register in your new county by the applicable deadline.

information_sections.title: Information Required
items: Social Security number; confidentiality is maintained
Optional information includes race, gender, and telephone number

information_sections.title: Registration Status and Applications
paragraphs: A precinct card is mailed after a voter registration application is approved. If you do not receive the card within two to three weeks, contact the local registration office.
Visit the Georgia Secretary of State website to check your registration status or locate your polling place.
Mail-in applications are available through the Secretary of State, county voter registration offices, and other mandated registration sites.
